title: HTTP Caching
definition: HTTP caching is governed by Cache-Control headers sent by the server. Directives like `max-age`, `no-cache`, and `immutable` explicitly tell the browser and intermediate CDNs exactly how long a resource is valid.
simpleExplanation: The server attaches an expiration date to files. 'This CSS file is good for 1 year. Do not ask me for it again until then.'
